title: NY Seeks $1.37 Billion Judgment Against Operators of NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Scheme
summary: Bitcoin Magazine NY Seeks $1.37 Billion Judgment Against Operators of NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Scheme Two successive crypto frauds took investors for more than $1.1 billion. Now New York's attorney general is asking a court to make the operators pay it back—with interest. This post NY Seeks $1.37 Billion Judgment Against Operators of NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
